mapper.select: SELECT CAR_NO carNo , CAR_NAME carName , CAR_PLATE carPlate , MAX_PASSENGER maxPassenger , COLOR color , STATUS status , REGISTER_DATE registerDate , CAR_LOCATION carLocation , CAR_BRAND carBrand FROM TB_CAR WHERE STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY REGISTER_DATE DESC

SELECT CAR_NO carNo , CAR_NAME carName , CAR_PLATE carPlate , MAX_PASSENGER maxPassenger , COLOR color , STATUS status , REGISTER_DATE registerDate , CAR_LOCATION carLocation , CAR_BRAND carBrand , IMG_ID imgId , I.ORIGIN_NAME imgOriginName , I.CHANGE_NAME imgChangeName , FILE_ID fileId , F.ORIGIN_NAME fileOriginName , F.CHANGE_NAME fileChangeName FROM TB_CAR C LEFT JOIN TB_CAR_IMG I USING (CAR_NO) AND I.STATUS = 'Y' LEFT JOIN TB_CAR_FILE F USING (CAR_NO) AND F.STATUS = 'Y' WHERE C.STATUS = 'Y' AND CAR_NO = #{carNo}
